text: Could you put the attached old kitchen photo and renovated kitchen photo side by side for me? I’ve been looking back at the kitchen project and would love to see the difference all together. I mean one landscape 16:9 image, with the old kitchen pic on the left labeled “Before” and the renovated kitchen pic on the right labeled “After”. Please keep both photos as they are and just fit them neatly into that image. It’s a little sentimental seeing how much the kitchen has changed.
